actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.desc: The kuunganisha magically turns invisible until it attacks, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the fiend wears or carries becomes invisible with it.

actions.desc: The kuunganisha makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fiend's darkvision.

traits.desc: The kuunganisha has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
traits.desc_ru: Совершает спасброски от заклинаний и прочих магических эффектов с преимуществом.
traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.desc: The fiend regains 1 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

traits.name: Regeneration

traits.desc: The master of the kuunganisha can cast a spell through the familiar, using the fiend's senses to target the spell. The range limitations are treated as if the spell originated from the kuunganisha, not the master. The spell effect occurs on the kuunganisha's turn, though the master must cast the spell during the master's turn. Concentration spells must still be maintained by the master.

ru.description: Маленькое исчадие. Класс доспеха: 13. Хиты: 17 (5к6). Скорость: ходьба 20 фт., полёт 40 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 6, ЛОВ 17, ТЕЛ 11, ИНТ 10, МУД 12, ХАР 13. Сопротивление урону: дробящего, огнём, электричеством, колющего, рубящего. Иммунитет к урону: ядом. Иммунитет к состояниям: отравление. Чувства: тёмное зрение 120 фт., пассивное Восприятие 11. Показатель опасности: 2. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 4, действий: 4.
ru.name: Куунганиша
